text: Bea said, “I want to welcome Theo.” Sam said, “I am hungry.” Bea borrowed the blue blanket. The welcome sign drifted toward the river. The picnic basket was unsteady. Sam caught the picnic basket. Bea held the blue blanket. Bea fetched the smooth stone. She placed the smooth stone on the blue blanket. She saved the sandwich for Theo. Theo said, “I am sorry.” Sam shared the cookie. Bea and Theo folded the blue blanket.
